title: Reba McEntire-backed Texas charity has welcomed over 35,000 families since 1992
summary_full: Established in 1992 by Reba McEntire, Reba's Ranch House serves as a sanctuary for families of hospitalized patients, having provided aid to over 35,000 families. The house offers not just accommodation and meals but also emotional and spiritual support through initiatives like Room for Hope. Many guests have experienced marked improvements in sleep and anxiety during their stay, reflecting the house's responsive growth to community needs.
